verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Framer's AI agent can restyle colors/typography/light-dark mode on request (framer-docs-27, framer-docs-37, framer-docs-19), but there is no documentation of an actual design-token or variables system with reusable modes/themes applied consistently across designs, akin to Figma variables. Missing for 10: token/variable definition, mode-based theme switching infrastructure, cross-file/theme propagation evidence.
